justification: The replication correctly implements the App-C chargon model (Eqs C19-C21) and demonstrates the three key qualitative claims: d-wave anisotropic splitting (max 8.06 on axes, zero on diagonals), spin-symmetric splitting (within-band spin splitting ~10^-15, essentially zero), and contrast with ordinary altermagnetism (spin polarization ~1.0). However, the full paper's headline claims require Schwinger-boson mean-field, SU(2)/Z2 gauge classification, and spinon-chargon convolution—all explicitly omitted. Only the reduced chargon sub-model is tested.
caveats: The replication covers only the simplified App-C chargon spectral model, not the full fractionalized altermagnet theory (spin-liquid classification, self-consistent mean-field, electron spectral function via spinon-chargon convolution). Parameter choices (H0=0.5) are not fully justified against paper values.
